chain: seq + previous_sha256 + SHA256(canonical event excluding its sha256);initial64zeros
append_checks: advance head only after successful fsync
publication: RESULTS.passed is only candidate requiring TEST_RUNS digest-checked commit
logs closed and fsynced before TEST_RUNS
commit includes all existing runtime file hashes and checkpoint head;external native exit must also match
atomicity: logical commit after digest verification;no rename-atomicity claim
recovery: only complete valid JSONL chain prefix is recoverable;trailing torn line has no evidence claim;preserve bytes
original_and_secondary_exceptions: stage/error type/code/errno/redacted traceback retained separately;both can coexist
unknown_policy: UNKNOWN/null retained,including R30 counters never reconstructed
limits: unwritable disk,deadline/output limit can prevent later writes
fsync is best-effort OS durability;no unconditional hardware/OS-crash guarantee
failure after journal close can leave only missing commit/native exit1 as evidence
